correctness.rationale: Exchangeability conditional on size is transitive and yields a uniform fixed-size matching. Counting prescribed disjoint edges gives all exact falling-factorial moments and the PGF. Normalized iid exponential circle gaps reduce reciprocity to local minima: single, adjacent, distance-two probabilities 1/3, 0, 2/15 give the exact mean and 2n/45 variance. Conditioning on the matching shared by two pairwise overlap variables gives covariance 8n/[405(n-1)^2]. Joint mixed factorial moments for fixed q have leading disjoint edge configurations and all collision configurations cost O(1/n); a bounded two-dependent CLT and concentration then give an independent Gaussian-Poisson joint limit. The included standalone exact checker passed 75 matching and circle enumeration assertions, including n<=7 fixed-size matchings and 86,400 n=6 circle rank/label arrangements. Finite tests support, but do not substitute for, the analytic limit proof.

value.rationale: Exact overlap p-values conditional only on observed reciprocal-pair counts give a dimension- and density-free calibration for independent repeated labelled point-cloud comparisons. For a fixed finite collection of comparisons, the theorem identifies the full joint null, including explicit finite O(1/n) shared-replicate dependence and asymptotic Gaussian-Poisson decoupling. This supplies a natural reproducibility test statistic and multiscale inference object, not merely a renamed marginal Poisson fact or an arbitrary numerical slice.
